mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a quiet, overcast start at 68 degrees, which feels like 67 degrees down at Badger Prairie County Park. We have a First Quarter moon phase tonight, though the overcast skies might obscure it, and there are no visible space station passes expected.

In city news, Verona is making big strides in green energy and transportation by installing anti-idling tech on its new ambulance and transitioning several police vehicles to hybrids. Additionally, apartment residents interested in green living can drop off food waste for composting at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop located on East Verona Avenue.

There are plenty of local events coming up in the next few days. You can start with Yoga at Insight Wellness on July 20th, followed by Hop Haus Trivia on July 21st. Then, on Wednesday, July 22nd, do not miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, featuring live music and local vendors.

In the weekly police recap, on Tuesday evening, July 7th, officers responded to an attempted retail theft of alcohol at a convenience store on Prairie Oaks Drive. Thanks to a store patron who interrupted the theft, a description of the fleeing vehicle was obtained, leading to the arrest of a 17-year-old girl for violating absolute sobriety and citations for her underage passengers.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Since the store is currently closed, you will have to wait until they open at 10 AM today to get your fix. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
